notes: A real 3D UI: lacquered wood plaques with gold edges that lift and tilt when you hover and press down when clicked (with a wooden tok sound), a 3D floating title, the journal as a lacquered book that swings open and tilts with your mouse, coin-style tool badge and ensō tokens, pill prompts and choices. Skis and a snowboard (in the ensō): first person, Steep-style physics: gravity, carving, tuck and brake, real airtime off ridges, spins and tricks, wipeouts, a speed gauge and a speed vignette. First person on the horse (V toggles): A/D turn, W go, mouse to look around. No more Player 2: whichever controller you touch is you. The camera sits closer, over your shoulder.
